scope: Bounded pack-and-sale-price planning in the existing commerce-admin app. Select own product, inspect multiple recorded competitor packs/prices, propose own pack/price options, compare side by side, retain a private reviewable draft. No physical repacking, stock/lot transformations, price updates, campaign activation, messages, production migration/data access, role grants, push or deployment.

mapping.feature: Recorded competitor observations and identity mapping
mapping.preserved: Existing catalog, manual capture (full-pack THB VAT-inclusive contract), matching, public/member observations and unique actions remain available. This slice only reads these sources.

mapping.taskEntry: Existing marketing task section and command navigation; one planning link for existing competitor-authorized roles. Sidebar remains at most nine entries; protected welcome navigation stays original.

mapping.distinct: Existing admin-only campaign-value rehearsal remains distinct from pack format/price proposals. Draft/request readers filter kind so each feature and Today sees only its own records.

routes./planning/pack-prices: Private persisted-draft index with bounded cursor pagination, actual draft status, empty/error/retry states and pending-request recovery.
routes./planning/pack-prices/new/{product,obser: Separate reloadable steps, browser history, recoverable unsaved input; deep review requires a new verified calculation.
routes./planning/pack-prices/drafts/:id: Retained original evidence and latest saved revision; ?saved=:requestId requires a matching durable server receipt before request success.
routes./planning/pack-prices/drafts/:id/edit/{p: Revision-protected editing; stale local input requires explicit use-latest or copy-values choice, followed by recapture and review.
routes./planning/pack-prices/requests/:id: Recover immutable original request before retry. Confirmed missing receipt allows the same packet; unknown lookup blocks retries; 409 requires current review.

access.MER: Unresolved existing competitor ACL gap; merchandising remains excluded. No broader permission granted.
access.BA: Existing global GET/HEAD-only rule remains; preview uses bounded GET, never a write exception. BA saving/editing remains unavailable.
access.ownership: Actor from authenticated server staff identity; no caller-selected owner/team/scope. Drafts and durable receipts are private to that actor.

readContracts: Reuse CompetitorPricesService.catalog(sku,true) and list(). Read-only local active catalog copy must be unique; never pull/sync Josh, scrape or capture observations during planning.

Preserve original decimal price, pack min/max/count, dimensional UOM, currency, VAT basis, public/member tier, date, mapping and source-configuration status. Maximum 200 recorded pairs/20 selected pairs/6 own proposals; incomplete coverage visible.

Manual observations inherit the existing explicit THB inclusive full-pack contract. Automatic currency/tax/source revision comes from existing configured source. Unknown or non-THB currency is excluded; no FX.

Fixed explicit catalog pack dimensions only. Gram/kg and ml/l normalize exactly, count requires whole pieces. No midpoint of ranges, guesses from names, count-to-weight without net quantity, or weight-to-volume conversion.

Mapping, dimensions, pack quantity/count, currency, tax, observed date, current source and freshness must support comparison. Missing, failed, future, stale or changed observations are excluded with visible reasons. Existing freshness interval is reused; upstream catalog freshness remains unverified.
No delivery/region equivalence is claimed; available public/member evidence remains distinct and market coverage is unverified.

calculation.arithmetic: BigInt rational decimals; half-up money 2 places, unit rate 6 places, percentages 4 places. Compare proposed minus competitor for the same pack quantity; no ranking/recommended selling price.
calculation.cost: The connected catalog has no authoritative internal cost. Connected cost is always null; extra per-pack cost assumptions cannot replace base cost. Competitor price is never internal cost; no caller-provided cost API.
calculation.futureAttestedCost: Shared deterministic calculation supports compatible SKU/UOM and effective-date internal cost only. Margin = gross profit / net revenue; markup = gross profit / cost. Zero cost has unavailable markup. Synthetic unit fixtures verify these formulas; this is not connected cost availability.
calculation.assumptions: Additional ex-VAT per-pack cost defaults to zero and requires a label when positive. Proposal prices are hypothetical, THB inclusive of known product VAT.
calculation.module: Browser-safe pure pack-price.ts inside the existing backend planning module; frontend imports the same code. Fits existing Nx app rootDir and Docker src/main.js without build-output or deployment configuration changes.

persistence.existingStorage: Existing commerce_promotion_drafts and commerce_promotion_draft_requests tables, scenario.kind=pack_price. No new table or migration file in app source; existing migration applied only to fresh owned synthetic local PostgreSQL fixture namespaces. Test reruns isolate a generated fixture namespace and preserve earlier test rows.
persistence.protocol: Advisory request lock, actor+request durable immutable receipt, canonical request hash, duplicate replay/different-intent conflict, row lock and expected revision CAS. Draft and receipt commit in one transaction. Save recaptures sources and requires matching fingerprint; original committed replay stays immutable.
persistence.browserRecovery: Owner-scoped session form backup and local immutable request journal verified before dispatch. Storage failure sends no write. Same-page duplicate clicks locked. Receipt shape, identity, expected revision, scenario and arithmetic verified before success.
persistence.operationalBoundary: Only private planning draft/receipt writes. Source SKU price and promotion rules remain unchanged. No physical stock, lot, warehouse, order repair, campaign or messaging writes.

interaction: Thai-first fluid cards, English locale, progressive additional assumptions, labeled inputs/selects, keyboard links, route-backed steps, visible inline errors, skeletons, server-persisted success, source retry and interrupted-flow recovery. No global CSS/font/welcome edits; no screenshots requested.

verification.fixtureMode: Built actual app, native existing competitor/catalog readers and pack controllers/services with owned localhost PostgreSQL. Synthetic repository evidence and local identity; real Nest authentication/role guards checked separately in HTTP tests.
verification.protected: Existing welcome source/style/font/API hashes, 20 welcome browser combinations, accepted Today and BA foundation rechecked. No fabricated screenshots or production claim.

remaining: MER competitor access needs an explicit ACL/source-contract decision; do not silently grant access.
BA remains read-only; saving needs a separate explicitly approved policy change.
No authoritative connected internal cost; profit/margin/markup remain unavailable in actual connected preview.
No FX, variable/range pack evaluation, weight/volume conversion, delivery normalization or authoritative market/price recommendation.
Catalog copy sourceVersion/freshness and comprehensive product picker remain unavailable in reused source contract; exact SKU entry reads the existing active local copy.
Production deployment/storage readiness and production-authenticated full-stack E2E are outside this bounded development slice; this is not the entire app redesign.
